title: catpart-fitness history row, schema v0
description: One line of the committed append-only fitness/history.jsonl (ADR-0001): exactly one row per run, accepted or rejected, each recording the corpus digest so a corpus change visibly invalidates comparisons. The scalars keep room for the per-level L1/L2/L3 ladder (ADR-0001) even though only L1 exists while catpart-inspect reports schema v0. Evolution is additive within a schema version: consumers must ignore properties they do not know, which is why additionalProperties stays true.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Bumped only by a breaking change of the history-row shape; additive changes keep the version.

run_id.description: Run identifier: UTC timestamp (YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ) plus six hex characters, unique per run. Names the full report in fitness/reports/<run_id>.json.

timestamp.description: UTC wall-clock instant of the run, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix.

tool_version.description: catpart-parser package version that produced the row (importlib.metadata; '0+unknown' when the package is not installed).

corpus_digest.description: SHA-256 of the corpus manifest file bytes. The manifest is the corpus registry (per-file SHA-256 digests included), so this binds the run to an exact corpus definition; a different digest voids no-regret comparison against earlier rows (ADR-0001).

accepted.description: Verdict of the run under the no-regret rule (ADR-0001): true for baseline runs and for increments where the Dev split rises and Held-out does not fall; false otherwise.

baseline_run_id.description: run_id of the last accepted row this run was compared against, or null when there is no baseline (first accepted run, or the last accepted row has a different corpus digest).

dev_rose.description: True when the Dev split rate strictly rose against the baseline; null when no baseline comparison happened.

held_out_fell.description: True when the Held-out split rate fell against the baseline; null when no baseline comparison happened.

reason.description: Fixed human-readable verdict string: why the run was accepted or rejected (including the baseline cases).

rate.description: Clean-parse rate on the Dev split: clean / total manifest rows in the split.

clean.description: Files classified clean on the Dev split.

total.description: Manifest rows on the Dev split (the rate's denominator, so missing-on-disk files count as not clean).

rate.description: Clean-parse rate on the Held-out split: clean / total manifest rows in the split.

clean.description: Files classified clean on the Held-out split.

total.description: Manifest rows on the Held-out split.

L2.description: Reserved for the L2 geometry-sanity scalar (ADR-0001); null until that level exists.

L3.description: Reserved for the L3 construct-coverage scalar (ADR-0001); null until that level exists.

report.description: Path of the full run report, relative to the fitness directory: reports/<run_id>.json.
